name: Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce – Create Discount Rules, Bulk Discounts, Coupons, BOGO Offers, Flash Sales
author: spluggy

sections.description:
SPLUGGY DYNAMIC PRICING IS A POWERFUL WORDPRESS PLUGIN THAT ALLOWS STORE ADMINISTRATORS TO CREATE DISCOUNT RULES, DYNAMIC PRICING RULES, BOGO OFFERS, BULK DISCOUNTS, COUPONS, FLASH SALES FOR WOOCOMMERCE PRODUCTS. WITH THIS PLUGIN, YOU CAN EASILY SET UP FLEXIBLE DISCOUNT STRATEGIES BASED ON USER ROLES AND SPECIFIC PRODUCTS

Are you still looking for ** Dynamic Pricing or Discount Rules ** plugins to boost your revenue next stage ? Wait it Over. Introducing Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce plugin, which will enhance your sales by providing features like discount rules, dynamic pricing, flash sales, BOGO deals, bulk discounts and many more. We are new so we may miss some features but we promise to add more and more in upcoming months with best level of support we can from our team

Contact Us
Customize your website

FEATURES OF FREE DYNAMIC AND DISCOUNT RULES PLUGIN

**1) Create dynamic pricing rules
**2) Flexible discount types (Percentage and Fixed Amount)
**3) Import/Export rules easily
**4) Easy EDIT and DELETE existing Rules
**5) Flexible discounts based on User Role and Products
**6) Discounts based on categories like Product, Cart, and Bulk
**7) Set priority of rules
**8) Set START and END date and time of rules campaign
**9) Auto search products smoothly
**10) View all Reports at one place ( Filter, Total discounts, Average discounts, Top performing discount rule, Order item )

HOW DYNAMIC PRICING PLUGIN WILL HELP YOUR SALES REVENUE

Boost Conversions with Smart Dynamic Pricing
Use powerful dynamic pricing rules to automatically adjust product prices based on quantity, user roles, or purchase history — helping you convert more visitors into paying customers

Offer Attractive Bulk Discounts
Set up bulk discount options to encourage customers to buy more items at once, increasing your average order value (AOV) and overall store revenue

Create Powerful WooCommerce Discount Rules
Easily configure WooCommerce discount rules for specific products, categories, or user groups — including percentage discounts, fixed prices, and special offers

Increase Sales Automatically
With automated dynamic pricing rules, your WooCommerce store can respond instantly to market changes, stock levels, or seasonal trends — helping you increase sales effortlessly.

Promote Limited-Time Discounts
Create urgency with time-based discounts and flash sales, encouraging quick buying decisions and reducing cart abandonment.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option, as WordPress handles the file transfer itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click Add New.

In the search field type “Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce” and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found our plugin you can view details about it such as the point release, rating, and description. Most importantly, of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce and uploading it to your webserver via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress contains instructions on how to do this here.

Does Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce plugin has import/export feature?

Yes, this plugin has both features listed in free version

Is it possible to add discount in percentage?

Yes, you can add discount in percentage too by mentioning particular value

Is plugin easy for use ?

Dynamic Plugin is very easy to understand even non-technical person can use
